description: How do I extract the data from THIS page? Fetches one public page and returns a ranked extraction plan: embedded JSON, JSON-LD, repeated records with CSS selectors and field names, tables, feeds, hidden API calls. Each source has a reliability, proof rows pulled from the real page, and the plan notes pagination and blockers. Set include_code for a starter Python script. Works on the raw HTML only, so JavaScript-built pages report a blocker instead of data. Use check_site first to learn whether the site allows scraping at all.

include_code.description: also return a starter Python script

name: xray_page
